Vario Shipping Group is looking for motivated candidates from Slovakia who would like to join our vessels and

• Assisting with loading and unloading operations

• Is willing to learn and develop professionally 
• Has sufficient English to communicate safely and effectively on board 
Experience in inland shipping, maritime work or a technical environment is an advantage, but not essential for 
every candidate. 
Experience on tanker vessels is also an advantage. 
Vario Shipping Group | EURES Recruitment – Slovakia 
Already qualified? 
If you already hold a recognised Boatman qualification for European inland shipping, we would be happy to 
hear from you. 
Your previous experience and qualifications will be taken into account when discussing your position and 
employment conditions. 
Training towards the Boatman qualification 
You do not need to hold the Boatman qualification when you apply. 
If you have the right motivation and are interested in building a career in inland shipping, Vario will look at the 
possibilities for you to develop towards the Boatman qualification. 
We will first explore whether the required training and examination can be completed in Slovakia.

development.
